lucas-release: Heads up — rolling out schema tweak to address index bloat during maintenance window 03:00 UTC. Plan: staged backfill in 3 waves (shard ranges A, B, C). Pin app workers to v4.2.1 during change. Abort if any live AccessExclusive >3s or if read latency p99 >250ms. tagging @simon-oncall
tereza: Ack. Who owns revert? Recommend SRE run `revert_index_swap.sh --shard <X>` and notify infra.
lucas-release: SRE owns revert. Runbook updated with exact commands. Short revert SQL snippet in runbook.
deploybot: deploybot: starting wave 1 (shard A). est ~4m. streaming to #release-stream
simon-oncall: Wave1 looks clean — no locks >200ms, p99 within baseline. Proceeding to schedule wave2 in 2m.
